title: Strategic Partnership Agreement

tracker.notes: by 15 Oct. Bhavin: 'huge for our Europe and Middle East pipeline'

verdict: Do not sign yet: 4 blocking issues to resolve
escalate: Conflict with a signed commitment and no waiver on file

findings.title: Breaches CloudSpan partner exclusivity in India and the GCC (until 31 Aug 2028)
findings.explanation: CloudSpan cl. 7.1 bars AtliQ and its Affiliates from acting as implementation, reseller or referral partner for any competing cloud data-warehouse / lakehouse / unified analytics platform in India or the GCC. This draft appoints AtliQ as a partner for such a platform with a territory including India and the GCC.
findings.suggestion: Limit the territory to Europe (which K deliberately kept free in the CloudSpan deal), or exit CloudSpan first (90-day mutual termination for convenience) and weigh the 12% referral revenue and certified-engineer commitment.
findings.quote: during the Term Partner and its Affiliates shall not act as an implementation, reseller or referral partner for any Competing Platform in India or the GCC.
findings.precedent: K on CloudSpan (Aug 2025): 'We can't do Europe — Europe is where we're growing.' Europe is free; India and GCC are not.

findings.title: Unlimited liability for one side
findings.explanation: The clause removes any cap on AtliQ's liability. Checklist: 'liability → 1x fees. NOT unlimited'.
findings.suggestion: Mutual cap at 1x fees paid/payable in the prior 12 months, with standard carve-outs (fraud, wilful misconduct, confidentiality) and a separate, insured super-cap for data breach.
findings.quote: 11.1 **By Partner.** Partner shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Datavane, its Affiliates and their respective directors, officers, employees and agents from and against any and all Losses arising out of or relating to (a) the Partner Services; (b) any breach of this Agreement by Partner or its Affiliates; (c) any representation made by Partner regarding the Platform; (d) any claim by a Datavane Account…
findings.precedent: Kessler Mobility (€120k): K walked away over unlimited liability — 'one bad incident … and the company is gone'.

findings.title: Only Datavane's liability is capped
findings.explanation: The cap protects Datavane only; the other side's exposure is open-ended.
findings.suggestion: Make the cap mutual: each party's aggregate liability limited to fees paid/payable in the prior 12 months.
findings.quote: 12.2 **Cap on Datavane Liability.** DATAVANE'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT, INCLUDING UNDER SECTION 11.2, SHALL NOT EXCEED TEN THOUSAND UNITED STATES DOLLARS (USD 10,000).

findings.title: New restriction on AtliQ's future business
findings.explanation: This clause limits who AtliQ can work for (up to 24 months). If signed it must be added to the commitment register.
findings.suggestion: Delete, or limit to active solicitation of named accounts AtliQ was introduced to, for the term only.
findings.quote: 5.3 **Non-Solicitation of Datavane Accounts.** During the Term and for a period of twenty-four (24) months following expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Partner shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates not to, directly or indirectly solicit, market to, or provide any implementation, migration, managed or consulting services to any Datavane Account in connection with any cloud data…

findings.title: Foreign governing law: State of Delaware
findings.explanation: A US state's law (State of Delaware) applied to the Indian entity. AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd would have to defend claims in US courts.
findings.suggestion: Ask for Indian law with Mumbai/Pune arbitration (Pvt Ltd) or a US state (Inc); fall back to a neutral seat such as SIAC/LCIA arbitration.
findings.quote: governed by the laws of State of Delaware

findings.title: Broad one-way indemnity
findings.explanation: One party indemnifies for anything 'arising out of or relating to' the services, while the other side's indemnity (if any) is narrow.
findings.suggestion: Narrow to third-party claims caused by the indemnifying party's breach, negligence or IP infringement, and make it mutual.
findings.quote: 11.1 **By Partner.** Partner shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Datavane, its Affiliates and their respective directors, officers, employees and agents from and against any and all Losses arising out of or relating to (a) the Partner Services; (b) any breach of this Agreement by Partner or its Affiliates; (c) any representation made by Partner regarding the Platform; (d) any claim by a Datavane Account…
